photos.c: Secretary to the Southern League, Divisions One and Six, Belgrave Southern League Team Manager, regular Coach at Battersea on Tuesday and Thursday evenings - Bob Bridges

The officials, pictured left, were (from the top left to right): Gordon Biscoe (timekeeper), John Sullivan (North London timekeeper), Don Anderson (timekeeper), Yak Stegner (Herne Hill timekeeper), Terry Earle (timekeeper), Pat Mead (track referee), Stuart Bennett (track judge), Bob Bridges (timekeeper), Richard Biscoe (track judge), Alan Mead (chief timekeeper), Leslie Earle (track judge). Not pictured but recording entries and assisting with the seeding was John Jeffery while starter was Bob Bush (Serpentine).

Delighted with their achievement of gaining promotion to UKWAL Division Three with an unbeaten run in 2005, the Belles enjoy the moment after the match at Abingdon.  Well done to all of them, but especially to Team Managers Cynthia James and Bob Bridges.

Above: At the home UKWAL match at Sutton the Belles just missed stretching their win streak to cover two complete seasons.  Another four match points would have done it – but they don’t seem too downhearted as they now look forward to 2007 and UKWAL Division Two.

From left to right – standing: Juliet Fielden, Katryna Euridge, Eva Massey, John Vernon, Sarah Gailey, Jayne Anderson, Chris Privett, Claire Robinson, Bob Bridges (Joint Team Manager), Cynthia James (Joint Team Manager), Rex Bale, Carl Lawton, Jennifer Culley, Tony Fairclough, Sarah Murphy, Derek Jones, Ray James. Kneeling: Sarah Wellstead, Janine Whitlock, Gail Porter, Dian Holden, Hazel Mead.
